name: hackathon-starter-template
description: Reusable, ultra-fast full-stack AI Hackathon Starter Template with Unbreakable Demo mode, Gemini API, and Supabase readiness.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
